author: Unreal Engine
description:
Unreal Model Context Protocol (MCP) provides an official, Epic-supported way to connect your favorite agentic LLM tools directly to Unreal Engine.
Built on the open MCP standard, it enables agents to take action in your projects using the capabilities exposed by each editor—so you can use compatible agentic coding tools or build your own integrations, skills, and workflows around how you create.

Docs:  https://dev.epicgames.com/documentation/unreal-engine/unreal-mcp-in-unreal-editor?lang=en-US

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=k0tgmrBuIJc&t=2s
